title: [P1][review,touch-target] Per-line review edit controls under the 44px touch target
goal: Every action on NeedsReviewRow/NewItemRow/FailedCard in review-detail.tsx ('Save & match', 'Confirm as new item', 'Mark non-inventory', 'Retry extraction', 'Confirm date') uses Button's size='sm' (h-8, 32px), well under the 44x44px target -- inconsistent with the Checkbox in the same rows, which correctly wraps its control in a 44px hit area (checkbox.tsx:35).
in_scope: Increase the touch target of the named per-line action buttons in review-detail.tsx to at least 44x44px -- either by changing their size prop or by wrapping them in a larger hit-area container if the visual size must stay compact.
Verify this doesn't cause layout crowding/overlap in the per-line row given how many actions sit adjacent to each other -- check both mobile and desktop widths.
out_of_scope: Changing button sizing on other pages -- this story is scoped to review-detail.tsx's per-line controls specifically; S-95 covers the equivalent issue on inventory consume-actions.
Any copy or icon changes to these buttons -- touch-target sizing only.
acceptance: The named per-line action buttons in review-detail.tsx have a touch target of at least 44x44px, consistent with the Checkbox's existing 44px hit area in the same rows, without introducing layout crowding at mobile widths.
invariants: Increasing touch target size must not cause adjacent per-line controls to visually overlap or become mis-tappable -- verify at the narrowest supported mobile width, not just desktop.
